maria-sec: Proposal: reduce dev SIEM retention 90d -> 14d to save costs.
jon-ops: how do we preserve evidence for investigations that need older dev logs?
kate-sre: keep prod 365d, schedule encrypted nightly exports to s3. dev exports off by default, opt-in via `retain_for_investigation` tag.
mike-infra: fine. Need RBAC: roles export:request, export:approve, export:download. Only security/forensics + legal can export.
ana-legal: legal needs Jira ticket + justification, requestor/approver fields, and a 7y audit trail. default legal_hold=false.
maria-sec: KMS concern: will CMK rotation break decryption of old exports?
mike-infra: keep previous key versions and allow decrypt for service principal; add rewrap runbook for corner cases.
kate-sre: require HMAC+manifest for every export. manifest must include export_id, timestamp, case_id, retention_days, legal_hold, hmac.
jon-ops: gate requests via Jira + OPA policy: auto-approve if incident_id present and requester in security team; otherwise require security lead approval. deny retention >365 without explicit approval.
mike-infra: sample upload command we will standardize and enforce SSE-KMS on bucket.
oncall-bot: deploy window 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC.
maria-sec: action items: infra IAM PR (mike), OPA + jira flow (jon), export job + manifest validator (kate), legal metadata schema (ana). I’ll draft RFC and link here. :thumbsup:
